title: Universal GT45 V8 Turbocharger Kit (T4 Flange, 3.5" V-Band, Intercooler & Fuel Upgrades)
description: Built to deliver serious airflow for large-displacement 4.0L to 6.0L V8 and heavy-duty 6-cylinder engines, this comprehensive GT45 turbo kit supports 500 to 650+ horsepower setups. The core turbo features a large 69mm inducer / 98mm exducer compressor wheel flowing up to 75–80 lb/min of air, paired with a high-flow 1.05 A/R T4 turbine housing to minimize exhaust backpressure at high RPMs. Designed to start spooling around 3,200 to 3,600 RPM on standard V8 engines, it maintains strong top-end volumetric efficiency up to 15+ PSI. This complete kit supplies all the supporting hardware needed for custom fabrication: a large 31x12x3-inch front-mount intercooler, 2.5-inch aluminum piping, a 38mm external wastegate, Type-RS BOV, 255 LPH fuel pump, adjustable fuel pressure regulator, auxiliary oil cooler kit, 0.75L catch can, 12-inch electric fan, and a 4-in-1 tachometer setup
